tree.heading: Gift Shop Account
tree.text: There shall be deposited in the Gift Shop Account all monies received from sales and other services by the gift shop established under section 2215 of this title, together with any interest accrued on balances in the Account.

tree.heading: Miscellaneous Receipts Account
tree.text: There shall be deposited in the Miscellaneous Receipts Account each of the following (together with any interest accrued on balances in the Account):

children.text: Any amounts deposited under section 2216(c) of this title.
Any other receipts received from the operation of the Capitol Visitor Center.
Any amounts described under section 2273(d) of this title.
